name: CoP - Provider B Completes, Provider A Changes Start Date
description: Provider A creates a short course and the employer approves it, but Provider A does not complete. Provider B then creates their episode for the same learner and course, the employer approves Provider B, and Provider B completes (claiming 30% and completion). Provider A then submits a PUT that shifts their start date by one day.

steps.name: SLD (Provider A) Creates a Short Course
Employer Approves Provider A Short Course
SLD (Provider B) Creates a Short Course
Employer Approves Provider B Short Course
SLD (Provider B) Claims 30% Milestone and Completes
Wait — inspect DB after Provider B completion, then continue
SLD (Provider A) Changes Start Date by 1 Day
